mechanism.statement: When native temporal correspondence is available at fixed denoise step/block, W2 low-rank approximation error can be decomposed into previous-coordinate error and innovation error. Under equal gate and continuous arithmetic, this yields a competing route to same-budget AC-sensitive W2 representation or explicitly paid anchored error transport; no current measurement establishes a video benefit.
mechanism.math_or_trace: Original BF16 V1[5120] -> W1[13824] -> tanh-GELU h -> W2 [5120]+b2 -> gate -> BF16 residual. With W, B=UV and E=W-B, e_tau,p=g_tau,p ⊙(h_tau,p E). For correspondence q, e_tau,p=e_prev,q + g_tau,p⊙[(h_tau,p-h_prev,q)E]+(g_tau,p-g_prev,q)⊙[h_prev,q E]. Same gate reduces to innovation term only. This is a continuous algebraic surrogate, not native BF16 two-GEMM bitwise identity. True previous e requires a paid dense/reference anchor or predictor; not inference-free. A new same-rank AC-weighted refit needs no motion warp. τ=0..20 latent-video time, t=0..3 denoise steps.

availability.earliest_decision_time: V1 cheap-source before W1 if producer actually exists; post-GELU h after full W1 for W2-only action; alignment oracle using Dense/optical-flow labels is OFFLINE_ONLY.
availability.observer_computation: Charge nearest-neighbor feature projection/search, source-time identity, memory/copy, error-anchor original W2 if used, optional low-rank correction and routing; previous tau output is not free in parallel Wan full-token batch.
availability.online_or_posthoc: Fixed xy latent distance and true full teacher output are offline observation; motion-aligned q* requires new native neighborhood and source video flow to confirm; Dense W2 error anchors are posthoc unless separately executed.

real_cost.W1: Retained for h-based M1/M2/M3; W1 saving only if an earlier V1 decision plus actual physically sparse W1 action is independently established.
real_cost.W2: r960 original two BF16 GEMMs; optional DC/AC weighted re-fit same MAC, added branch/anchor/warp must compete with same-cost static rank.
real_cost.QDQ: BF16_ORIGINAL has no FP4 activation code or scale; HiF4 fakeQDQ and native NVFP4 separate numerical lanes.
real_cost.routing_memory: Motion search, gather/scatter, adjacency, packed tile, anchor refresh and synchronizations counted; baseline whole video tokens are parallel not autoregressive.
real_cost.downstream: Multi-source genuine 160-site full-video, motion magnitude plus semantic action/direction and fair repeated end-to-end system costs OPEN.

countermechanism.statement: The apparent temporal similarity may be inherited from V1; r960 may preserve same-input AC and lose video motion through prefix-state/attention changes, or RAFT motion may misrepresent semantic action. Motion nearest neighbors may be false due to occlusion/repeated textures and cost more than they save.
countermechanism.prediction: Dense-h gated AC error not selectively larger than DC, same-cost AC refit does not improve source-held direction; student-state divergences/quality change after full rollout; matched-neighbor oracle adds no gain beyond fixed-xy or static rank.

discriminator: First audit full21tau actual EXIT. For all source/step/block 21tau×8xy, replay both r960 native BF16 factors on identical Dense h and measure DC/AC signed alignment, typed postwrite and source tails; collect real spatial neighborhoods for fixedxy/nearest/random/flow-oracle; only then test fixed-rank AC-aware refit or paid-anchor transport and full160 student video.
